app.name: Alarm clock
app.summary: An alarm you set on the screen or from Home Assistant, with Snooze and Stop when it rings.
app.setting_on_hint: Whether the alarm rings at its time.
app.setting_hour_hint: The hour the alarm rings, 0 to 23.
app.setting_minute_hint: The minute the alarm rings, 0 to 59.
app.setting_weekdays_hint: Rings Monday to Friday and stays silent at the weekend.
app.part_sound_hint: The alarm's sound, over and over for ten minutes, or until you tap Snooze or Stop. Follows the screen's volume.
app.setting_sound_hint: The sound when the alarm rings, on a screen with a speaker. It follows the screen's volume.
app.setting_tone_hint: Which sound rings: Beeps, Gentle chime, Rising or Classic alarm.
app.setting_snooze_hint: How long Snooze waits before the alarm rings again, 1 to 30 minutes.
